files.name: lib/Thread.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
	import { Module, Bubble, Divider, Reply } from 'mercury';
	import MessageCircle from '@lucide/svelte/icons/message-circle';

	let messages = $state([
		{ text: 'Cupertino Philz at 3 tomorrow work for you?', time: '9:42 AM', outgoing: true },
		{ text: 'Perfect. I have a thing at 4:30 nearby anyway.', time: '9:44 AM', outgoing: false },
		{ text: 'Bringing the portfolio prints you asked about 👀', time: '9:44 AM', outgoing: false }
	]);
	let newCount = $state(2);

	function send(text) {
		if (!text?.trim()) return;
		messages = [...messages, { text, time: 'Now', outgoing: true }];
	}
</script>

<Module title="Danny Trinh" source="Messages" icon={MessageCircle} more="Open thread">
	{#each messages as m, i}
		{#if i === messages.length - newCount}
			<Divider label="New messages" />
		{/if}
		<Bubble text={m.text} time={m.time} outgoing={m.outgoing} avatar="DT" />
	{/each}

	<Reply placeholder="Message Danny…" onsend={send} />
</Module>
